Position Title

SAP SD QA Tester (Manual Testing)

Location - Bengaluru

Experience
2+ Years of Relevant SAP SD QA Expertise

Employment Type

Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We is looking for a highly skilled SAP SD QA Tester to join our growing technology team supporting strategic SAP and S/4HANA initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating SAP business processes, ensuring application quality, and delivering reliable testing solutions across SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and related modules.

This role requires strong expertise in SAP SD Manual Testing, test planning, defect management, and Agile delivery methodologies. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, developers, and cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality releases and seamless business operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test cases and test scenarios for SAP applications, primarily focusing on SAP SD.
  • Perform Functional Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, System Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Validate end-to-end SAP business processes across SAP SD and integrated modules such as MM, FICO, and S/4HANA.
  • Identify, document, track, and retest defects using tools such as JIRA, HP ALM, or similar defect management tools.
  • Collaborate closely with business users, SAP functional consultants, developers, and project stakeholders to resolve issues and validate fixes.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed test plans, test scripts, test execution reports, and release signoff documentation.
  • Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Analyze business requirements and ensure complete test coverage for functional and technical changes.
  • Support release management activities and production validation testing.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by suggesting testing process enhancements and quality best practices.
  • Assist in automation, performance, and security testing initiatives whenever required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have Skills

  • 2+ years of overall experience in SAP Testing.
  • Strong hands-on experience in SAP SD QA Manual Testing.
  • Ability to independently execute SAP SD testing activities with minimal supervision.
  • Strong understanding of SAP Sales & Distribution business processes.
  • Experience testing SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
  • Proven experience in software quality assurance methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Strong expertise in creating:
    • Test Plans
    • Test Strategies
    • Test Cases
    • Test Scenarios
    • Test Execution Reports
  • Experience with defect tracking and management tools such as JIRA, HP ALM, Quality Center, or equivalent.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to SAP MM and SAP FICO modules.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks.
  • Exposure to performance and security testing.
  • Experience working in large MNCs or globally distributed teams.
  • Knowledge of end-to-end SAP business process integrations.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Information Security Engineer to strengthen our security posture by designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-grade security controls across applications, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve the organization's information security strategy, policies, and standards.
  • Monitor and protect enterprise infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments against cyber threats.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and penetration testing coordination.
  • Investigate security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and lead incident response activities.
  • Design and implement security controls for cloud infrastructure, applications, and endpoints.
  • Review and enforce Secure Software Development Life Cycle (Secure SDLC) practices across engineering teams.
  • Work closely with development, DevOps, IT, and product teams to ensure security is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Configure and manage firewalls, endpoint protection, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and security monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, and incident response procedures.

  • Recommend and implement automation to improve security monitoring, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare security reports, risk assessments, and remediation plans for leadership.

  • 4–6 years of experience in Information Security, Cyber Security, Security Engineering, or Infrastructure Security.

  • Strong knowledge of:

  • Experience securing Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments, including IAM, networking, and access controls.

  • Experience developing security policies, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Google Cloud Security services.
  • Knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar security frameworks.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning tools such as Nessus, Qualys, or OpenVAS.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or Bash for security automation.
  • Security certifications such as CEH, Security+, CISSP, CCSP, GCP Security Engineer, or equivalent are an added advantage.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reduced security vulnerabilities and faster remediation.
  • Strong compliance with security policies and industry standards.
  • Secure cloud infrastructure with minimal security incidents.
  • Improved application security through Secure SDLC implementation.
  • Effective incident response and continuous security monitoring.
